diagnostics.title: Purity Not Proven
diagnostics.messageFormat: Method '{0}' is marked [EnforcePure], but its effects do not prove observable purity
diagnostics.description: Unknown or observable effects prevent an [EnforcePure] success verdict.

diagnostics.title: Allocation In [ZeroAllocations] Method
diagnostics.messageFormat: Method '{1}' is marked [ZeroAllocations], but operation '{0}' allocates
diagnostics.description: Reports a known allocation in a [ZeroAllocations] method.

diagnostics.title: Disallowed Capability Use
diagnostics.messageFormat: Method '{1}' is marked [AllowedCapabilities], but operation '{0}' requires capabilities: {2}
diagnostics.description: Reports known capabilities outside the declared set.

diagnostics.title: Capability Contract Not Proven
diagnostics.messageFormat: Method '{1}' is marked [AllowedCapabilities], but operation '{0}' could not be capability-verified: {2}
diagnostics.description: Reports capability contracts whose rich effect summary remains unknown.

diagnostics.title: Invalid SharpProof Contract Argument
diagnostics.messageFormat: SharpProof contract '{0}' has invalid argument '{1}': {2}
diagnostics.description: Reports malformed SharpProof contract or control arguments.

diagnostics.title: Invalid SharpProof Analyzer Configuration
diagnostics.messageFormat: SharpProof analyzer option '{0}' has invalid value '{1}': {2}
diagnostics.description: Reports invalid compilation-global SharpProof analyzer options.

diagnostics.title: Precondition Violated
diagnostics.messageFormat: Call to '{0}' violates precondition '{1}'
diagnostics.description: Reports only compiler-bound preconditions that concretely replay as false.

diagnostics.title: Exception Contract Violated
diagnostics.messageFormat: Method '{0}' is marked {1}, but operation '{2}' can throw disallowed exceptions: {3}
diagnostics.description: Reports known escaping exceptions outside the declared exception contract.

diagnostics.title: Zero-allocation Contract Not Proven
diagnostics.messageFormat: Method '{0}' is marked [ZeroAllocations], but allocation freedom could not be verified: {1}
diagnostics.description: Reports [ZeroAllocations] methods whose rich effect summary remains unknown.

diagnostics.title: Exception Contract Not Proven
diagnostics.messageFormat: Method '{0}' is marked {1}, but its exception behavior could not be verified: {2}
diagnostics.description: Reports exception contracts whose rich effect summary remains unknown.

diagnostics.title: Selected Analysis Incomplete
diagnostics.messageFormat: SharpProof could not completely analyze selected method '{0}': {1}
diagnostics.description: Reports selected methods outside the supported analyzer subset.

diagnostics.title: Compiler Manifest Emission Failed
diagnostics.messageFormat: SharpProof could not emit the final compiler manifest: {0}
diagnostics.description: Reports a fatal failure to attest the compiler's final compilation.

diagnostics.title: Contract API Could Not Be Verified
diagnostics.messageFormat: SharpProof could not verify the referenced SharpProof.Attributes assembly, so contract analysis is disabled: {0}
diagnostics.description: Reports that the contract API assembly could not be read or attested, which silently disables all contract analysis.

diagnostics.title: Invalid ContractFor target
diagnostics.messageFormat: Contract companion '{0}' does not identify one resolvable named target type
diagnostics.description: Validates compiler-bound ContractFor companion declarations without textual signature reconstruction.

diagnostics.title: Duplicate ContractFor companion
diagnostics.messageFormat: Target type '{0}' has multiple ContractFor companions; exactly one is required
diagnostics.description: Validates compiler-bound ContractFor companion declarations without textual signature reconstruction.

diagnostics.title: Invalid ContractFor companion type
diagnostics.messageFormat: Contract companion '{0}' must be a static class whose generic arity and constraints exactly match target '{1}'
diagnostics.description: Validates compiler-bound ContractFor companion declarations without textual signature reconstruction.

diagnostics.title: Missing ContractFor member
diagnostics.messageFormat: Target method '{0}' has no exact ordinary companion member in '{1}'
diagnostics.description: Validates compiler-bound ContractFor companion declarations without textual signature reconstruction.

diagnostics.title: ContractFor member signature mismatch
diagnostics.messageFormat: Companion method '{0}' does not exactly match a target overload, including receiver, generic constraints, ref kinds, nullability, and return type
diagnostics.description: Validates compiler-bound ContractFor companion declarations without textual signature reconstruction.

diagnostics.title: Ambiguous ContractFor member
diagnostics.messageFormat: Companion mapping for method '{0}' is ambiguous
diagnostics.description: Validates compiler-bound ContractFor companion declarations without textual signature reconstruction.

diagnostics.title: ContractFor member body required
diagnostics.messageFormat: Companion method '{0}' must have a compiler-bound source body
diagnostics.description: Validates compiler-bound ContractFor companion declarations without textual signature reconstruction.

diagnostics.title: Invalid ContractFor clause placement
diagnostics.messageFormat: Contract.{0} in companion method '{1}' has invalid placement: {2}
diagnostics.description: Validates compiler-bound ContractFor companion declarations without textual signature reconstruction.

diagnostics.title: ContractFor companion targets itself
diagnostics.messageFormat: Contract companion '{0}' cannot target itself
diagnostics.description: Rejects ContractFor relationships whose companion and target are the same type.

diagnostics.title: Cyclic ContractFor relationship
diagnostics.messageFormat: Contract companion '{0}' targets '{1}' in a ContractFor cycle
diagnostics.description: Rejects ContractFor relationships that participate in a cycle of companion and target types.

diagnostics.title: Forbidden compiler API
diagnostics.messageFormat: API '{0}' is forbidden in soundness-critical SharpProof layers
diagnostics.description: Compiler APIs that synthesize or speculatively bind source, use display text as identity, or enumerate whole compilations are forbidden.

diagnostics.title: Mutable static state
diagnostics.messageFormat: Mutable static storage '{0}' is forbidden in analyzer, frontend, and verifier layers
diagnostics.description: Analysis state must be compilation- or worker-scoped.

diagnostics.title: Cancellation is swallowed
diagnostics.messageFormat: Catch handler for OperationCanceledException must rethrow cancellation
diagnostics.description: Cancellation is control flow and may not be converted into a semantic answer.

diagnostics.title: Semantic string controls behavior
diagnostics.messageFormat: Reason or provenance literal '{0}' may not control semantic behavior
diagnostics.description: Closed enums and typed records must represent semantic reasons and provenance.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostic descriptor bypasses the catalog
diagnostics.messageFormat: DiagnosticDescriptor instances must be declared in the generated catalog
diagnostics.description: Diagnostic descriptors are generated static fields with stable identifiers and help links.

diagnostics.title: String field in program IR
diagnostics.messageFormat: String field '{0}' is forbidden in SharpProof.Ir
diagnostics.description: Semantic identity in the program IR must use scoped typed identifiers.

diagnostics.title: Assumption bypasses the trusted boundary
diagnostics.messageFormat: Assumption instances may only be created by allowlisted proof setup code
diagnostics.description: Only allowlisted proof-producing code may turn justified predicates into assumptions.

diagnostics.title: Effect summary bypasses the trusted boundary
diagnostics.messageFormat: EffectSummary instances may only be created by allowlisted effect-domain code
diagnostics.description: Trusted effect summaries must be constructed by the effect domain, operations, or external-spec resolver.

diagnostics.title: C# expression text is synthesized
diagnostics.messageFormat: String concatenation may not synthesize C# expression text containing '{0}'
diagnostics.description: Soundness-critical layers must bind compiler operations rather than construct source expressions as text.

diagnostics.title: Non-cacheable semantic answer
diagnostics.messageFormat: Timeout, error, failure, and Unknown answers may not be written to a semantic cache
diagnostics.description: Transient and abstaining results are not stable semantic facts and must not be cached.

diagnostics.title: Proof outcome bypasses the trusted kernel
diagnostics.messageFormat: '{0}' instances may only be created by the proof kernel
diagnostics.description: Only the proof kernel may construct proven or refuted outcomes and replay-validated models.
